hooks.name: Privacy scan
hooks.description: Blocks agent writes containing high-confidence sensitive data without printing the matched value. Infrastructure failures fail open; the required privacy scan in CI is the fail-closed backstop.

action.command: sh -c '[ -f "scripts/privacy_pretooluse_hook.py" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "scripts/privacy_pretooluse_hook.py"'
